title: Roasted Pumpkin Cream Soup with Shrimp
summary: Cream soup of oven-roasted pumpkin, carrot, onion, bell pepper, garlic and ginger blended with cream. Served with seared shrimp, grated tomato, pumpkin seeds and croutons.

nutrition.basis: per 300 g serving of soup, 20% cream, without toppings (toppings add 150–200 kcal and 15–20 g protein)

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.note: a pinch, ~1/4 tsp — easy to overdo

shopping_list.item: Spices: curry, nutmeg, sweet paprika, black pepper

steps: Cut the pumpkin, carrot, onion and pepper into medium chunks. Cut the top off the garlic head. Slice the ginger thinly.
Add thyme and spices, drizzle with olive oil, toss.
Roast about 35 minutes at 180 °C (356 °F) with convection — the vegetables should brown slightly, that is where the flavor comes from.
Separately warm the water with the cream; do not boil.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins, keep only thyme leaves. Transfer everything to a blender, add the warm cream and water, blend until completely smooth.
Serve topped with seared shrimp, grated tomato, pumpkin seeds and croutons.
tips: Too thick — thin with hot water; too thin — simmer gently a few minutes without boiling.
Lenten/vegan version: skip shrimp, replace cream with coconut milk.
10% cream saves ~170 kcal for the whole pot; 33% cream adds ~230 kcal.
storage: Soup without toppings keeps 2–3 days in the fridge.

source.note: Quantities from the video description, serving from the video narration
